proposals.before: In Baoda year 1 Southern Army commander-in-chief Yelu Yudu and his mother Literary Consort secretly plotted to put him on the throne; when the plot was exposed Yudu defected to Jin, Literary Consort was executed, and Aolugan, who had not joined the plot, was spared.
proposals.after: In Baoda year 1 Southern Army commander-in-chief Yelu Yudu and Aolugan's mother Literary Consort secretly plotted to put him on the throne; when the plot was exposed Yudu defected to Jin, Literary Consort was executed, and Aolugan, who had not joined the plot, was spared.
proposals.reason: 其母文妃 refers to Aolugan's mother (established in s0182), not Yudu's mother; "his mother" wrongly attaches to Yudu.

proposals.before: In the first year of Baoda, Southern Army commander-in-chief Yelu Yudu and his mother Literary Consort secretly plotted to install him; when the affair was discovered Yudu surrendered to Jin, Literary Consort was executed, and Aolugan had in truth not joined the plot and was spared.
proposals.after: In the first year of Baoda, Southern Army commander-in-chief Yelu Yudu and Aolugan's mother Literary Consort secretly plotted to install him; when the affair was discovered Yudu surrendered to Jin, Literary Consort was executed, and Aolugan had in truth not joined the plot and was spared.
proposals.reason: 其母文妃 is Aolugan's mother, not Yudu's; literal "his mother" misattributes the kinship.

decisions.reason: Chinese wraps the sons note in 〈…〉; English already uses parentheses, so the trailing 〉 is a stray markup artifact and should be removed.
Same stray closing corner bracket on the literal field; remove the trailing 〉 while keeping the parenthetical English.
Chinese wraps the son note in 〈…〉; the trailing 〉 in English is leftover markup, not part of the meaning.
Literal likewise retains a stray 〉 after the parenthetical translation of the 〈…〉 annotation.
In 性樂道人善，而矜人不能, 矜 means pity/forbearance toward others' inability, parallel to praising goodness—not severity in judging people.

decisions.after: By nature he delighted in praising others' goodness and was forbearing toward those who lacked ability.
decisions.reason: The original misreads 矜人不能 as harsh judgment; the proposal's sense is right, but "those who could not" is incomplete English—complete as "those who lacked ability."
In 余睹與其母文妃密謀立之, 其母文妃 is the biography subject's (Aolugan's) mother; English "his mother" after Yudu wrongly makes Literary Consort Yudu's mother.
Literal "his mother" likewise misattributes 其母文妃 to Yudu; naming Aolugan's mother restores the correct kinship.
